checks_run.procedure: Independent probe of F-DG1-137/F-DG1-218 over a generated matrix of 125 file names (13 middle segments x 9 final extensions, plus 8 named cases; 112 of them are collected by walk()), not the implementer's fixed list. Checks: (1) isDeclarationFileName() equals TypeScript's public SourceFile.isDeclarationFile AND the runtime @internal ts.isDeclarationFileName for every name. (2) For every name walk() collects (CODE_FILE), fileViolations() never throws and never yields 'Debug Failure', valid content gives no 'unparseable source', and a real syntax error yields '<modules/...path>: unparseable source:'. (3) The real src/modules tree is walked and linted without throwing, with 0 violations. Also runs the candidate's architecture.test.ts with --reporter=verbose to show the two new F-DG1-137/218 self-checks and the F-DG1-217 self-checks green.

So the fix, not chance, makes the tests green.
